Scan new commits on the unchanged branch found nothing new, as expected

article_plural_slips: "Nobody needs to approve, it is automatic" — inaccurate: a person assigns each finding
sentences_to_rerecord: Nobody needs to approve, it is automatic. You can just merge them.

accuracy.anchor: Scan-type choice and the N+1 shape appear only in passing; the leak, the webhook and the whole lifecycle are missing, and the governance answer is wrong (anchor: 6–10 = one or two points, one inaccuracy).

structure.anchor: Feature list instead of a headline; no evidence or next step anywhere (anchor: 5–8 = parts missing).

customer_relevance.anchor: No yes/no for the CTO and "many, I didn't count" (anchor: 3–5 = no numbers).

brevity_and_fluency.anchor: Twelve fillers, two tag questions, two long pauses; objections far under target (anchor: 2–4).

recovery.anchor: Objections dismissed without acknowledgement or evidence (anchor: 0–2).

stems: "The risk is… for both brands." — open with what the customer loses, not what the product has.
"I will run three scans, not twelve, because…" — choose and justify.
"Nothing opens a pull request until a person assigns it" — state the control before you are asked.
